# Youhanna Meleka

> Co-founder and CEO of Ficio, building embodied AI for a healthier, more resilient global food supply chain, starting with in-field apple harvesting and sorting robots. Formerly Global Supply Manager at Tesla. MEng in Semiconductors and Quantum Materials at Cornell University. Based in Ithaca, New York.

Site: https://ymeleka.com/
Thesis in one line: food scarcity is an engineering problem.

## Work
- Ficio (https://www.ficio.org): co-founder and CEO. Robots that harvest and sort apples in the orchard, with perception, grading and a data layer that learns from every apple.
- Cornell University: MEng, Semiconductors and Quantum Materials; research on wide-bandgap semiconductors in the Jena-Xing Lab; data center architecture projects (power, cooling and compute for AI at scale).
- Tesla: Global Supply Manager for closures, electro-mechanical parts and seals; recognized as Tesla Top Talent.
- Penn State: B.S., Industrial, Systems and Manufacturing Engineering.

## Involvement
- Cornell University Physical Intelligence: Founding Board Member (https://cornellphysicalintelligence.com)
- Big Red Ventures: Deep Tech Diligence and Sourcing (https://www.brventurefund.com/)
- Entrepreneurship at Cornell (https://eship.cornell.edu/)

## Story
Born and raised in Cairo, Egypt. Started a first business at fourteen and worked in manufacturing by sixteen. Studied how things are made at Penn State, ran supply for Tesla in California, then went a layer deeper into chips at Cornell, where Ficio began.
